ELEGANT SMALL GOLD WATCH FOR WOMEN
 Crafted for small wrists, the CIVO petite gold timepiece showcases a retro silhouette accented by Roman numerals for understated elegance. Its clean, minimal design transitions effortlessly from jeans to jacketed meetings.
A Japanese quartz movement and long-life battery deliver steady, accurate seconds; the stretch stainless-steel bracelet snaps on without tools, and 3 ATM water resistance guards against splashes or suds.
Presented in a slim gift box, this versatile gold watch is ready to thank Mom, celebrate a bride, or reward a colleague—marrying daily function with refined feminine flair.

GOLD WATCH SPECIFICATION
 Small Gold Watch Case Diameter (length * width): 24.5 * 19.5 mm
 Small Gold Watch Case Thickness: 7.5 mm
 Small Gold Watch Band Width: 6 mm
 Small Gold Watch Weight: 20.5 g

GOLD WATCH PACKAGE CONTENTS
 1 * CIVO Small Gold Watch
 1 * Watch Box
 1 * Gold Quartz Watch Instructions
 1 * Gold Watch Microfiber Cleaning Cloth

items.label: ELEGANT ROMAN DIAL DESIGN
items.value: A refined oval case adorned with a smooth golden coating, paired with a dial featuring Roman markers. Perfectly blending vintage charm with modern sophistication, it elevates your confidence and presence for everyday wear, weddings, evening galas, or business occasions

items.label: ADVANCED JAPANESE QUARTZ & WATER RESISTANCE
items.value: Equipped with imported Japanese quartz movement and a durable, high-quality battery for precise timekeeping, 3 ATM water resistant, suitable for handwashing, splashes, and daily wear

items.label: EXPANSION STAINLESS STEEL BAND
items.value: Features a soft and flexible stainless steel expansion band that fits comfortably around the wrist without tools; perfect for stylish women during daily commutes and social events, ideal for small wrists below 5.9 inches

items.label: IDEAL GIFT FOR WOMEN
items.value: A timeless gift choice for middle-aged women, business professionals, moms, wives, girlfriends, or yourself; elegantly packaged for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Christmas, and other special occasions

items.label: CUSTOMER SERVICE SUPPORT
items.value: CIVO values every customer experience. Each watch is crafted under strict quality control and inspected before packaging. If you have any questions or need assistance, our responsive service team will provide timely support to ensure a worry-free shopping experience

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Watch Box, Instruction Manual, Cleaning Cloth
